scope: Selected current decision checks related to marked-content property resources and membership dictionaries.

decisions.topic: Inline dictionaries and named Properties resources
decisions.review: Retain the two-form resolver. The source permits direct property dictionaries inline and requires a named resource when a list has an indirect value. Current parser/interpreter supports the name route; a remaining assertion-quality gap is specifically that no accessibility/text extraction test was found for named resource + indirect ActualText. The draft targets that public consumer, rather than redefining property-list syntax.
decisions.status: narrow assertion gap drafted; no production finding

decisions.topic: Streaming marked-content state across Contents pieces
decisions.review: Retain. The existing public test opens a marked sequence in one page Contents-array stream and closes it in the next, with visible/hidden controls. This is not repeated in the present draft.
No source mismatch found in the reviewed property operand paths; these implementation-organization decisions do not change the Table 352 forms.

decisions.topic: Undefined optional-content property resource in archive processing
decisions.review: Keep scoped to archive treatment of undefined optional-content resources. It does not create a general requirement to reject a missing /Properties name during content interpretation.

ADR 0017 establishes the rendered visibility obligations and membership-policy implementation; ADR 0178 scopes page reachability for the layer UI; ADR 2684 handles an undefined named OC property in archive validation. Current optional_content_cells_current contains controls for single-group OCGs, policy/VE precedence, and null-reference neutrality. The older optional_content_current summary that called null neutrality uncovered is stale; do not elevate it to a present defect.
decisions.status: current tests retained; no new draft
